ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Freeze on Child Care Funding
ideas.description: This story would investigate the reasoning behind the Trump administration's decision to freeze $10B in child care funding and its impact on affected states.
questions: What was the reasoning behind the Trump administration's decision to freeze child care funding?
How will this decision impact affected states?
searches: Trump administration child care funding freeze
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant information about the Trump administration's actions and their impact on the public. By following the money and examining public records, we can gain a deeper understanding of the motivations behind this decision.
